observations.code_quote: The Rust and Python cache builders omit a non-v1 flag and its dependents instead of failing the team's rebuild, as the [service cache section](./hypercache-system.md#service-cache-rust) describes.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies that both Rust and Python cache builders omit unsupported flags rather than failing the team rebuild, and points to the relevant service cache documentation.

observations.code_quote: The feature-flags Rust evaluation service uses a separate HyperCache instance defined in `products/feature_flags/backend/flags_cache.py`. Unlike the local evaluation cache (which serves SDKs with cohort definitions and group type mappings), the service cache provides raw flag data plus pre-computed dependency metadata so the Rust service can evaluate flags in the correct order without recomputing the dependency graph on every request.
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies the location of the HyperCache instance and its purpose, while also documenting the caching behavior.

observations.code_quote: Before anything serializes or reads a flag, `_omit_unsupported_flags` classifies each stored `filters` document with `detect_config_format` (`products/feature_flags/backend/facade/config.py`).
observations.posthog_connection: Clarifies the classification and omission of unsupported flags before serialization and reading, and documents the behavior of omitting unsupported flags and their dependents.
